newsitem.title: CANADA: IPL says oil pipe expansion startup in '96.
newsitem.headline: IPL says oil pipe expansion startup in '96.

text.p: IPL Energy Inc said on Tuesday that the first phase of its crude oil pipeline expansion was expected to be in service by the end of this year and the second phase in the last half of 1998.

The expansions, which are expected to cost C$710 million in total, will add 290,000 barrels per day to the Interprovincial system. The system moves oil to the U.S Midwest and southern Ontario from Alberta.
IPL also said it finalized agreements in October to provide a joint tariff covering shipments of Canadian crude to Patoka, Illinois area refineries.
The agreements, announced in principle early this year, also include IPL investing US$18 million and taking a 30-percent interest in Mobil Corp's Mustang pipeline.
The Mustang line extends to Patoka from IPL affiliate Lakehead Pipe Line's Lockport, Illinois terminal.
